SSB SI (Non-GD) PET PST Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the PET PST Exam Date Notce for the recruitment of SI (Staff Nurse, Pioneer, Communication) posts on the official website of SSB. This recruitment has been issued for 51 posts. The online correction process for SSB SI (Non-GD) Recruitment 2026 has started from 06 May 2026, and the candidates can apply until 08 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SSB SI (Non-GD) PET PST Exam Date 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 March 2026
  • Last Date : 04 May 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 06-08 May 2026
  • PET PST Exam Date : August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 00/-
  • All Female : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
